changes.title: Upgrade Lunar Ephemeris to VSOP87 Engine
changes.description: Replace the current simplified moon position algorithm with the full VSOP87 planetary theory for sub-arcsecond precision at all latitudes.

changes.title: Cross-App SSO Session Protocol
changes.description: Implement unified cryptographic JWT session management across Web Portal (3000), Command Center (3001), and API (4000) with HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookies.

changes.title: Witness Engine V2 Schema Migration
changes.description: Restructure the Witness knowledge graph schema to support the new engine module system with typed evidence candidates and score profiles.

changes.title: Fix Southern Hemisphere Qibla Algorithm
changes.description: The great-circle bearing calculation produces inverted results below the equator. Requires correction in the core @moon/compute qibla module.

changes.title: Immutable Audit Trail for Zakat Allocation
changes.description: Introduce Merkle-tree cryptographic receipts for every approved financial movement in account.move to guarantee mathematical unalterability.

changes.title: High-Frequency MQTT Stream for Bosscha Dome
changes.description: Deploy low-latency telemetry transport between physical dome rotary sensors and the MoonWitness Command Center telemetry dashboard.

changes.title: Automated Slew-Limit Safety Cutoff for 14-inch Telescope
changes.description: Introduce hardware and software interlocks preventing telescope slew into pier limits when pointing near zenith or below horizon.

changes.title: JPL DE442 Long-Span Ephemeris Cache Preloading
changes.description: Cache lunar nutation and libration polynomials for 1448-1450 H in Redis memory store to reduce CPU compute cycles during live sighting sessions.

changes.title: Standardized Crescent Contrast Index (CCI) Formula Deployment
changes.description: Formally adopt the Crescent Contrast Index metric into the video ingestion pipeline for objective optical hilal validation.

changes.title: Zero-Trust Role Delegation for Regional Sighting Committees
changes.description: Grant granular temporary observer credentials to verified regional Falakiyah teams with geographical geo-fencing verification.

changes.title: Real-Time DIMM Turbulence Telemetry Integration
changes.description: Stream Fried parameter r0 directly into ephemeris visibility models to dynamically adjust imkanur rukyat confidence scores.

changes.title: Cryogenic Cooling Thermal Interlock Automation
changes.description: Automatically cut off power to Peltier elements when heat sink temperature exceeds 48 deg C to prevent thermal sensor damage.

changes.title: PostgreSQL TimescaleDB Continuous Aggregates
changes.description: Pre-aggregate raw weather and seeing telemetry into 1-minute, 5-minute, and 1-hour rollup views to accelerate frontend charting.

changes.title: Uthmani Font Kerning & Harakat Normalization in Vector Renderer
changes.description: Implement HarfBuzz-based text shaper for SVG rendering of Quranic verses in celestial infographics.

changes.title: Automated Satellite Debris Photobomb Filter
changes.description: Correlate optical crescent captures against Space-Track TLE orbital elements to discard glints from Starlink and OneWeb satellites.
